about_the_game:
Co-op experience play with friends

The darkness has awakened. And fear is your enemy.
When ancient rituals disturbed the balance of the world, humanity faced a horror it could never foresee. Demons broke loose. The ground split open. Cities were swallowed by the abyss. But alongside the chaos, ancient crystals emerged — capable of sealing the portals to the demonic realm.
You are one of the few sent into the heart of darkness.

🔥 Game Features:

🧟 Atmospheric horror in a dark fantasy world
Abandoned villages, blood-soaked altars, fire seeping through the earth — every step is steeped in fear.

🪄 Survival with minimal resources
Only spells, potions, and artifacts. No weapons. No mercy.

👁️ Fear system
The more afraid you are, the more visible you become to the darkness. Monsters sense it. Hunt it. Feed on it.

📈 Character progression
Develop skills, manage fear, unlock rare abilities, and adapt to survive and complete your mission.

🗝️ Rituals & Bosses
Find ritual items, bring them to the altar, summon the boss, and use crystal powers to defeat it. Earn boss crystals as trophies for your personal lobby.

🕯️ You're not fighting evil. You're fighting yourself.
Pilgrim of Darkness isn’t just about demons.
It’s about the fear that grows inside you.
Gather the crystals. Perform the rituals.
Before the darkness finds you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i12
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: Explore a dark fantasy world, collect crystals, perform rituals, and survive demons before fear consumes you. Survive in the dark where fear makes you visible to demons. Rituals, upgrades, bosses—every step could be your last.
supported_languages:
English*, Ukrainian, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
